# OppositeNumber

> OppositeNumber is a Guildford, Surrey studio that designs, builds and looks after AI-driven systems and processes for growing businesses. Real developers, not just tools: we automate the work that slows a business down and keep it secure and compliant as it grows. Fixed-price audits and 10-day sprints, published engagement models, founders accountable for every project. The name: your opposite number is the person on the other side who makes things work.

## Services

- [AI Services](/ai-services): AI Opportunity Audit, 10-Day AI Sprint, Fractional AI Lead, AI Product Development, Business Process Automation, Data & AI Readiness, AI Adoption Programme, AI Governance & Security, AI Search Visibility (GEO)
- [Digital Services](/digital-services): Product Strategy & Roadmaps, Proof of Concept, Mobile App Development, Web Platforms & SaaS, Marketing Websites & Headless CMS, Design Systems, Digital Branding
- [Approach & Pricing](/approach): how we work and what it costs
- [AI Readiness Scorecard](/ai-readiness): a five-minute self-assessment
